description: This file declares functions and structures related to reachability analysis in a version control system, likely Git. It contains function prototypes for marking reachable objects, adding unseen objects to traversal, and reporting recent objects, as well as forward declarations of relevant structures.

methods.name: add_unseen_recent_objects_to_traversal
methods.description: Adds unseen recent objects to a traversal, potentially invoking a callback for each object.

methods.name: mark_reachable_objects
methods.description: Marks objects as reachable within a traversal, based on parameters such as reflog and recent timestamp.

ctags.name: report_recent_object_fn
ctags.pattern: /^typedef void report_recent_object_fn(const struct object *, struct packed_git *,$/
